scope: Seven real SQLite/service corruption and cross-operation probes
No Policy implementation re-review, no new grader or provider work
source_snapshots: Full pre-fix copies of the five reviewed backend files and post-fix copies of those files plus the unchanged probe are included as .txt. Red source before/after checks and green six-file before/after checks were unchanged.

findings.evidence: Three failed cases: replacing an old create receipt with another active own attempt result redirected the key; altering cached question stem or frozen question ref hash returned inconsistent allocation data.
findings.fault_model: Direct SQLite test-only corruption of idempotency.result_json; request hash and key retained. This does not claim a public SQL-write capability or a normal user ability to alter the database.
findings.fix: Immutable assessment_receipts bind the live idempotency instance created_at/request hash to its actual allocation hash and canonical result hash; replay obtains the sealed target, rechecks current Policy and compares immutable public fields to the true assignment. Expiration cascades the old binding; original status/revision receipts remain historical.

positive_probes: Concurrent final response save versus submit has one authoritative winner with no mixed response array or duplicate grading intent.
Changing submitted outbox event type, workspace binding or event binding blocks GET and submit replay without repairing or creating work.
limits: Seven probes are not full platform or milestone acceptance; the root performs whole-branch gates separately.
The bounded run is SQLite plus real service/import worker calls, not a browser or all-route HTTP acceptance.
Shared runtime and fixture dependencies were ongoing development state; exact source stability is asserted only for the explicitly listed reviewed files.
No score, certification, academic model use, or public deployment completion is asserted.

public_derivative.references: All artifact filenames refer to this package. Original private absolute directories are omitted.
